usage: agentbreeder cost [-h] [--state-dir STATE_DIR] [--json] [--stack DIR]
                         [--environment ENVIRONMENT] [--since DAY]
                         [--until DAY] [--by {deployment,model}]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --state-dir STATE_DIR
  --json
  --stack DIR           Use the operator config and state that `services up`
                        wrote for DIR
  --environment ENVIRONMENT
                        With --stack: the stack environment
  --since DAY           First UTC day, YYYY-MM-DD (default: 29 days before
                        --until)
  --until DAY           Last UTC day, YYYY-MM-DD (default: today)
  --by {deployment,model}
                        Group the table by deployment key (default) or by
                        model; --json has both
